name: @kauro/control
description: Kauro control plane: the outbox dispatcher over the B06 dispatch store and leases, the source-lifecycle consumers (UPLOAD_INSPECTION, SELECTION_EVALUATION, STORAGE_LIFECYCLE, AUTHORITY_JOURNAL) the source sweepers (upload deadlines, provider session reconciliation, retention, object inventory, deletion retries, location policy), and — where the execution providers are bound — processing and audit authority's consumers (JOB_EXECUTION, EXECUTION_CONTROL, AUDIT_ORCHESTRATION, PLAN_VALIDATION) and sweepers (JOB_ADMISSION, ATTEMPT_MONITOR, JOB_DEADLINES, STAGING_JANITOR, AUDIT_DEADLINES, GRANT_RECONCILIATION), each in SYSTEM units of work bound to the work item's agency.
